svg.title: EduRate
svg.desc: EduRate: Education review platform with a leaderboard and an admin moderation panel, in Azerbaijani, English and Russian. Built with Next.js, i18n AZ · EN · RU, Vercel. Live at edu-rate-nu.vercel.app.
